description.zh: 指定要移入网络域的主机ID。
description.en: The IDs of the hosts that you want to add to the network domain.

description.zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeInstances](~~153281~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The bastion host ID.

> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query the bastion host ID.

description.zh:
指定要移入的网络域ID。
> 您可以调用[ListNetworkDomains](~~2758827~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the network domain to which you want to add hosts.

> You can call the [ListNetworkDomains](~~2758827~~) operation to query the network domain ID.

description.zh:
堡垒机的区域ID。
> 区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见[地域和可用区](~~40654~~)。
description.en:
The region ID of the bastion host.

> For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

title.zh: 批量将主机移入指定网络域

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost move-hosts-to-network-domain --instance-id bastionhost-cn-uax2zmx8005 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --network-domain-id 2 --host-ids 1,2 --region cn-hangzhou
